<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2015/06/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>eleviewer</id>
    <version>1.3.6</version>
    <title>EleViewer</title>
    <authors>karefined-eng</authors>
    <owners>karefined-eng</owners>
    <description>EleViewer solves a specific problem: students and researchers juggle several heavy apps just to read a PDF, write notes, and view a Word document or spreadsheet. It brings those workflows into one ~135MB portable Windows executable with built-in text-to-speech for PDFs.

File Support: Opens & edits DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, CSV, HTML, and TXT — all in one workspace.

Reading & Study Tools:
- PDF text-to-speech — reads lectures/PDFs aloud for hands-free studying using native Windows SAPI voices (works offline)
- Persistent bookmarks — never lose your place, even in 400-page textbooks
- Split-screen web browser — press Ctrl+T to research side-by-side with your documents

Organization:
- Vault sidebar — one-click access to course folders
- Quick switcher — fuzzy file search like VSCode (Ctrl+Q)
- Session restore — reopens all tabs right where you left off

Specs:
- ~135 MB, single portable .exe — no traditional installation needed
- No account, no telemetry — files stay local
- Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit)
- GPLv3 open source
- SHA256: 0FA547D30B6A88C35D7F35A0EDF36145493734A17317D87DB5506ED20544C393</description>
    <projectUrl>https://eleviewer.vercel.app</projectUrl>
    <projectSourceUrl>https://github.com/karefined-eng/eleviewer</projectSourceUrl>
    <licenseUrl>https://github.com/karefined-eng/eleviewer/blob/main/LICENSE</licenseUrl>
    <iconUrl>https://eleviewer.vercel.app/icon.png</iconUrl>
    <tags>portable offline text-to-speech student no-telemetry open-source no-admin windows pdf-reader docx-viewer</tags>
    <packageTypes>
      <packageType name="Portable" />
    </packageTypes>
  </metadata>
  <files>
    <file src="tools\EleViewer-1.3.6-portable.exe" target="tools" />
  </files>
</package>
